name: The Sabbath Day
overview: The Sabbath Day is established by God as a holy and sanctified day of rest, commemorating His rest after creation (Genesis 2:3). Scripture commands believers to remember and keep the Sabbath holy by ceasing from work and honoring it as a sacred convocation dedicated to the Lord (Exodus 20:8; Leviticus 23:3; Deuteronomy 5:12). Isaiah emphasizes the attitude of delight and reverence toward the Sabbath, encouraging believers to turn from personal pleasures to honor God on this day (Isaiah 58:13). Furthermore, the Sabbath serves as a sign of God's sanctifying presence among His people, marking their identity as those set apart by Him (Ezekiel 20:12).
